FEAT-3-S117.description: Implement core logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API using condition and location inputs, enforce RECRUITING status filter, and normalize trial metadata for downstream processing.

FEAT-3-S118.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation
FEAT-3-S118.description: Compute travel distance and duration from user location to each clinical trial site using Google Routes API and attach results to trial records.

FEAT-3-S119.title: Clinical Trial Location Extraction and Formatting
FEAT-3-S119.description: Extract trial site locations from API response, normalize address fields, and format for consistent display and distance computation.
